viewerNote: Only members can edit. Ask an admin for the member role.

inbox.hint: The readiness check fails until EDIT ME files are filled in.

grader.title: 1. How answers are checked
grader.description: Exact answer needs no model. Rubric judge uses a pinned model.
grader.fixed: Graded by this benchmark's own tests. Only Q&A benchmarks can switch grader.
grader.fixedToolUse: Graded by this benchmark's own script. Only Q&A benchmarks can switch grader.

hint.tests: Hidden tests run on the agent's code change.
hint.state: A script checks the state the agent left behind.
hint.exact: Exact, contains all, number, pattern or choice.
hint.judge: A pinned model grades each answer against your rubric.
hint.toolCalls: A script checks the agent's tool calls and replies.

grader.votesHint: Judge calls per answer. Majority decides.
grader.pinHint: Each grade records this model and prompt. Uses your organization's key.

add.title: 2. Add tasks
add.description: New tasks are used only after readiness checks pass.
add.issuesHosted: Needs a connected GitHub repository, hosted site only.
add.codeSuite: Spreadsheets and tickets need a Q&A benchmark. Create one first.
add.traces: Production failures arrive in the inbox. Open one and choose Turn into task.

rows.help: One row per task. Columns: question, answer or rubric. Optional: id, title, wrong_answers (split by |), category, split (held_out).
rows.ticketsHelp: JSON array, JSON Lines or plain text: subject, message, then Expected: line. Separate tickets with ---.
rows.ticketsNeedJudge: Ticket replies need Rubric judge. Switch the grader first.
rows.csvPlaceholder:
question,answer,wrong_answers
How many days is the refund window?,30,14 | 60
rows.jsonlPlaceholder:
{"question": "How many days is the refund window?", "answer": "30"}
{"instruction": "Summarise our refund policy", "rubric": "Mentions the 30 day window", "reference": "Refunds within 30 days."}
rows.ticketsPlaceholder:
Charged twice
I was billed two times in May.
Expected: Apologise, confirm the duplicate charge and refund it within 5 days.
---
Cannot log in
The reset link expired.
Expected: Send a new reset link and say it lasts one hour.
rows.heldOut: Keep private (held out). Used only when asked, never shown.
rows.generatedWrong: Written by Heimdall from your answer. Edit in verifier/answer.yaml.
rows.verbatim: The agent gets each task's text as written, no added prompt.
rows.tooBig: Over 48 MiB. Split into files of up to 20000 rows.
rows.background: Large import, runs in the background.

map.title: Map columns
map.help: Choose which column feeds each part of a task.
map.metadataHint: Ticked columns go into each task's details.
map.saved: Mapping saved for the next import.

attach.label: Attached files
attach.help: Up to 5 MiB each, 40 MiB total.
attach.tooMuch: Attached files are over 40 MiB in all.

private.title: 3. Private tasks
private.description: Never run unless an evaluation asks, never shown. Catches agents tuned to public tasks.
private.empty: No tasks yet. Add some above.

readiness.title: 4. Readiness checks
readiness.description: Only tasks that pass are used in evaluations.
readiness.confirm_one: Run readiness checks on 1 task? It builds an image and runs on a worker, usually a few minutes.
readiness.confirm_other: Run readiness checks on all {{count}} tasks? It builds images and runs on a worker, a few minutes per task.
readiness.confirmHosted_one: Run readiness checks on 1 task? Scripted answers, no model calls.
readiness.confirmHosted_other: Run readiness checks on all {{count}} tasks? Scripted answers, no model calls.
readiness.confirmHostedJudged_one: Run readiness checks on 1 task? Your judge model grades it, about {{calls}} calls on your key.
readiness.confirmHostedJudged_other: Run readiness checks on all {{count}} tasks? Your judge model grades them, about {{calls}} calls on your key.
readiness.judgeConsent: Calls {{provider}}/{{model}} about {{calls}} times on your organization's key.

check.honest: The reference solution passes the original tests (try {{n}})
check.instruction: The instruction was written for this task
check.secrets: No secrets in the task files
check.staleNotes: Stale project notes do not break the right answer
